shortDescription: Netherlands 10 Year Government Bond Yield increased to 3.65%, the highest since April 2011.Over the past 4 weeks, Netherlands 10Y Bond Yield gained 36.02 basis points, and in the last 12 months, it increased 70.13 basis points.
